description: Source code for the HttpDecoder class in the QUIC protocol implementation, handling HTTP/3 frame decoding and processing.

classes.name: HttpDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding HTTP/3 frames in QUIC, managing frame states, parsing payloads, and invoking visitor callbacks.

methods.name: DecodeSettings
methods.description: Static method to decode SETTINGS frames from raw data.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data buffer, advancing the decoding state machine.

methods.name: ReadFrameType
methods.description: Reads the frame type from the input stream.

methods.name: ReadFrameLength
methods.description: Reads the frame length from the input stream.

methods.name: ReadFramePayload
methods.description: Reads the payload of the current frame.

methods.name: FinishParsing
methods.description: Finalizes parsing of a frame and triggers end callbacks.

methods.name: ResetForNextFrame
methods.description: Resets internal state to prepare for decoding the next frame.

methods.name: HandleUnknownFramePayload
methods.description: Handles payloads of unknown frame types.

methods.name: BufferOrParsePayload
methods.description: Buffers payload data or parses it if complete.

methods.name: ParseEntirePayload
methods.description: Parses the entire payload of a frame once buffered.

methods.name: BufferFrameLength
methods.description: Buffers the length field of a frame.

methods.name: BufferFrameType
methods.description: Buffers the type field of a frame.

methods.name: RaiseError
methods.description: Sets error state and notifies visitor of an error.

methods.name: ParseSettingsFrame
methods.description: Parses SETTINGS frame payload into a SettingsFrame structure.

methods.name: MaxFrameLength
methods.description: Returns maximum allowed length for a given frame type.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current decoder state for debugging.
